sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-owned conditional SN-curve selection requirement, including exclusive known/unknown branching through the single boolean selector, required known-curve selection/type/correspondence evidence, and the required two-slope controlled value when unknown.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add sh:maxCount 1 to nltl:stressLifeCurveKnown so contradictory branch-selection values cannot pass. Do not place nltl:stressLifeCurveType on the nltl:stressLifeCurveSelection value node: its authoritative requiredOwner is ship; require it on the ship in the applicable known-curve branch with xsd:string. Constrain nltl:stressLifeCurveSelection values to sh:class nltl:stressLifeCurveTypeValue (including the known branch), while retaining the unknown branch's required nltl:twoSlopeStressLifeCurve value and the known branch's correspondence evidence.

Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-owned conditional SN-curve selection requirement, including exclusive known/unknown branching through the single boolean selector, required known-curve selection/type/correspondence evidence, and the required two-slope controlled value when unknown.
